anchor.semantic_hook: Playing with fire is staged literally through a tabletop game whose board, counters, and dice are all made of flame.
anchor.setting: An empty recreation room contains a low game table, two chairs, and plain shelving for changing situation props. A complete tabletop game made entirely of steady flame rests on the table without scorching it.
anchor.absurd_element: a complete playable tabletop game made entirely of steady flame

inserts.action: stands uneasily across the game table from his seated boss, offers two visibly contradictory geometric charts, and hides crossed fingers behind his back
sits upright in the boss's chair, compares the conflicting charts with a suspicious frown, and points sternly toward the flaming game

variations.scene_adjust: a boss's chair, two contradictory geometric charts, a closed office briefcase, and a neat desk tray

inserts.action: leans over the game table, empties every coin from his savings jar onto one small new-company model beside the flaming pieces, and watches with tense excitement
reaches urgently across the table to stop the last coins, braces one hand against the empty savings jar, and stares at the single investment with alarm

variations.scene_adjust: an empty savings jar, a mound of coins, one small new-company office model, and an otherwise empty investment tray

inserts.action: sits as Marco beside the flaming game, pushes a dusty stack of untouched tax forms away with one elbow, and pulls a bulging coin pouch protectively to his chest
stands beside Marco with a grave expression, points from the neglected tax materials to the burning game pieces, and raises one hand in warning

variations.scene_adjust: a dusty stack of blank tax forms, several sealed unmarked envelopes, a bulging coin pouch, and a miniature civic office building

inserts.action: perches eagerly at the table edge, grips a flaming game counter between both hands, and recoils when the fiery dice roll toward him
leans over the opposite side of the table, reaches excitedly for the flaming dice, and jerks his face back from the sudden heat

variations.scene_adjust: the flaming board opened for active play, fiery counters near both chairs, and the flame dice rolling between the two players

inserts.action: stands beside the game table as a new employee, accepts a ring of work keys with a hesitant hand, and glances anxiously at the completely empty document tray
faces him as the employer, extends the work keys across the flaming board, and keeps his other hand firmly over an empty contract folder

variations.scene_adjust: a ring of work keys, a packed tool case, a completely empty document tray, and an empty contract folder

inserts.action: slouches in a student chair beside the flaming game, turns away from his closed textbooks, and idly spins a fire counter instead of studying
leans toward him with an urgent expression, points emphatically at the untouched study materials, and holds one palm toward the burning board in warning

variations.scene_adjust: a student chair, closed textbooks, untouched blank flash cards, pencils, and a clock whose hands are close to the exam hour
